summary: The screen isn't just too big. It spends its space on the wrong things. In explore about 15% of a 1280x800 screen is simulator chrome: a title card with crowd counts and a 360x195 control panel with a time slider, 6 view buttons and 4 speed buttons. Compose adds a 520x330-420 card at bottom-centre, about 34% of the screen in total, right where the clicked resident usually stands. Nothing on screen tells the player why 老周 differs from 美咲 or what they could try for. That is the root of critiques (3) and (4). The two cheapest high-impact fixes are both UI work, and both stay honest. First, turn the whisper card into a 'role-as-tool' card built only from engine-true data: persona.actions, the phone relations, and credulity (which really bounds confidence in view.ts L100). Second, add a small Goose-style list of 5 micro-goals that are checked only against played, validated events, with a stamp toast at the moment the event actually plays. I checked 66 full-cast Gemma lab runs plus 8 recorded runs. Two of the owner's example goals are almost never reached: the mayor makes a public statement in 1/66 runs and a shop closes in 4/66 (about 6%). So the visible goals use reachable outcomes: town-wide spread 61%, uncovering a true secret 53%, newspaper article 23%, stage closed 21%, police deployed 11%. The rare ones become hidden discoveries. Everything else collapses into a light default HUD: a clock/festival-countdown pill with a drawer, a cast strip, a goals tag, one 'now happening' line and a corner speed pill, about 4-5% of the screen. TownScene.tsx and director.ts are being edited right now (TownScene changed at 10:57), so anchor edits by function name. Also keep the lab/e2e.mjs selector strings, or update that file in the same change.

Permanent chrome is about 157k px², roughly 15% of the screen, all controls or counts. Nothing says what is happening in town. COMPOSE: the Hud cards stay up (TownScene L340-343), plus the compose card, GameUI L568-610, bottom-6 centred, 520x330, or about 420 with 4 history rows. It covers the resident, and selecting does not reframe the camera (CameraRig L69-145 never reads ui.selected). (b) meanwhile pill L630-634, top-14. (c) act title L625-629, top-13%, 2.2 s. Good. (d) CaptionBar L74-98, bottom-24, up to TWO stacked cards of about 670x75 each, text-base semibold. It repeats long 'found' lines already in the bubble (director.ts ≈L543 only marks finds up to 60 chars as bubbled), and it stays on during results (L623), overlapping the panel. (e) Controls L112-156, bottom-3, 720x44. Nine to eleven controls: pause, 1×/2×/3×, 重播, 導演, mute, progress with ticks, a 14px clock, stall timer and 看結果. Tool-like. The most dramatic number, story time against 20:00, is tiny. (f) EndTitle L363-376 for 4.2 s. Good. (g) In the scene: Says bubbles 230-240px (Says.tsx L78-144), the thinking pill (L61-76), the power chip (PlaybackLayer L23-41), threads (L113-130) and world signs (L150-235). This is the right visual language; give it more of the load. Missing: a glanceable 'who knows it now' and a persistent 'what is happening right now'. RESULTS: the panel (L265) is right-4 inset-y-4, 460x768, about 35% of the screen. The order is stats first: seed, then 4 stat tiles (L272-284), then the reach line and compare. The headline (StoryCardView L21-25) only comes after that. Highlights (L302-308) duplicate drift/found/truth. The footer (L334-356) has 11 buttons, including 7 identical orange 告訴X. CaptionBar still overlaps on the left.

Below that are ability chips (🚓 派警力 · 🚧 封鎖舞台 · 🔍 親自檢查), '📞 會打給：林市長、美咲、志明' and '耳根軟 ●●○○○'. Chips that could finish an unfinished micro-goal glow orange with '🎯 有機會'. proposals.title: '今晚的小目標': a Goose-style notepad of 5 optional micro-goals, with stamp toasts
proposals.player_experience: A small paper tag at top-right reads '🎯 今晚 1/5'. Hovering or tapping unfolds a slightly tilted note: ○ 🗣️ 全鎮都在傳, ✓ 🔎 歪打正著：揭開一個真問題 (struck through in orange), ○ 📰 登上霧港小報, ○ 🚧 讓舞台被封鎖, ○ 🚓 讓警察出動, plus '隱藏目標 0/5 ???'. Each open item has a one-line hint ('誰有權派警力？'). In a story, a stamp toast '🎯 達成！🚓 讓警察出動' drops under the tag with a chime, on the beat when the dispatch actually plays, never earlier. Hidden ones ('🤝 讓死對頭說上話', '🚪 讓一家店拉下鐵門', '✊ 攤商上街', '🎩 逼市長公開表態', '🏮 燈籠節取消') appear as surprises. Results and the end title show the stamps from this run, marked NEW. Nothing is gated; the note just answers 'what can I play for?'.
proposals.inspired_by: Untitled Goose Game to-do list (light, crossed out, hidden items); Two Point level goals; Hitman challenges; Plague Inc. achievements
proposals.implementation:
New src/town/goals.ts with Goal = { id, icon, zh, hint, hidden?, tools?: ActionKind[], test(evs: SimEvent[]): boolean }. Visible goals (hit rates from 66 full-cast Gemma lab runs): viral, heard.size>=6 where heard = deliver targets with data.via!=='inspection' (61%); secret, an e.type==='inspect' whose data.found includes the check.zh of any FACTS entry with check.by==='expert' && value (53%; FACTS is an array, scenario L45); paper, any 'article' event (23%, tools publish_article); stage, a state event with data.key==='stage' (21%, tools close_stage); police, a state event with data.key==='police' (11%, tools dispatch_police). Hidden goals: rivals, a talk/phone not missed between a pair whose relations trust<=0.3 (47%); shop, a state event with key starting 'shops.' and to==='closed' (6%); rally, a 'gather' event (5%); mayor, a 'statement' by mayor (1.5%); festival, a state event with key 'festival' (0 so far). Persistence: localStorage 'viral.goals.v1' with every read/write in try/catch. It is a per-viewer convenience. GameUI: load in the L406-410 effect. While playing, compute goalsDone(show.order.slice(0, show.i)) only from played events. Diff against a ref that resets when show.loads changes; on a new id, set the toast {icon, zh, until: now+3500}, save, and play an sfx chime. Do this only for Gemma or recorded runs, never for the __viralRules dev path (L428-435). GoalsChip, top-right, every phase except results:
. When open (state, so taps work on touch):
with the heading '今晚的小目標（隨意玩）'. Rows are '✓/○ icon zh'; done rows use 'text-slate-400 line-through decoration-orange-400 decoration-2'; open rows get the hint in 'block pl-5 text-[11px] text-slate-400'. Footer line '小目標只看鎮上真的發生的事 · 隱藏 {h}/5'. Toast:

🎯 達成！{icon} {zh}

proposals.risk: It could pull players toward 'beating' the model instead of watching. Keep it to 5 visible goals, with no timers, scores or progress bars. The owner's own examples (mayor statement 1.5%, shop closure 6%) are rarely reached today. They are hidden on purpose, or need engine and prompt tuning by the lead, not UI promises. Recheck the hit rates after the lead's interaction-session rework, because conversation changes could shift them.

proposals.title: NowLine: a single 'what is happening now' line replaces CaptionBar, the meanwhile pill, the stall timer and the simulating card
proposals.player_experience: One slim subtitle line above the bottom edge always names the current beat: '🚶 老周正趕去麵包店', then '🔍 老周在麵包店仔細檢查', then '📰 快訊：小雯發文〈…〉' in a newsroom-amber style that holds for 4 s. While Gemma is working it reads '💭 老周在想…（Gemma 推演中 6 秒）'. After 9 s it changes to '👀 同一時間，麻糬在發呆…'. Boxes never stack, and a line already shown over someone's head is never repeated. At the end it reads '🏁 故事結束 · 看結果 →' as a button. The player always knows what to look at without reading a panel.

(2) fresh = show.captions.filter(c => show.clock - c.at < 5 && !(ui.follow && (c.tone==='speech' || c.tone==='thought' || c.bubbled))).at(-1). (3) show.stalled with show.thinking.size gives thinker names plus <StallTimer/> (L100-110, unchanged). (4) show.meanwhile shows its label (absorbs L630-634). (5) Otherwise, the zh of the last played event among move/meet/talk/phone/look/inspect/state/notice/article/statement/gather in show.order.slice(0, show.i), dimmed. JSX: <div className='pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-14 flex justify-center px-3'><div key={k} className={`pointer-events-auto flex max-w-[min(92vw,600px)] animate-[fadein_0.25s_ease-out] items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-[15px] leading-snug shadow-md backdrop-blur-sm ${TONE[t]}`}>. TONE = { base:'bg-slate-900/75 text-white', dim:'bg-slate-900/55 text-white/85', news:'bg-amber-300/95 font-semibold text-slate-900', seed:'bg-violet-600/90 text-white', system:'bg-slate-200/95 text-slate-700' }. Text goes in <span className='line-clamp-2' title={full}>. The 看結果 button appears when show.status==='done' || !show.growing (the old L151 logic). Render at L623 for playing and simulating only. director.ts ≈L543: drop the `String(d.found).length <= 60` condition so any shown find counts as bubbled; NowLine then shows the inspect-start zh instead of the full find. The act title (L625-629) moves to top-[10%] at text-base so it clears the top bar. Clicking flies the camera to that resident and opens the whisper card, so nobody has to hunt the map. During a story the tokens show the spread at a glance. Grey and desaturated means not yet heard; an orange ring means heard. The fill shows belief: rose = believes, amber = doubts, grey = rejects. A 💭 dot means Gemma is thinking for them, and a small badge (🚓 📰 ✊ 🚪) marks a big action. A '5/8' sits at the end. This replaces the '影響居民 5' tile with something that fills up while you watch.

For each n of ALL_RESIDENTS filtered by ui.active: heard = show.infected.has(n) (director L100); st = show.stance[n] (L112); thinking = show.thinking.has(n) (L107); big = the icon of the first played state/article/gather/statement/notice event with actor n. Button: 'relative grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-base transition max-sm:h-6 max-sm:w-6'. While playing add the fill (bg-rose-200 / bg-amber-200 / bg-slate-200 / bg-white) and either 'ring-2 ring-orange-400' or 'opacity-50 grayscale'. In explore and compose add 'bg-white hover:scale-110' and 'ring-2 ring-sky-400' when selected. Badges: 💭 and {big}. Click in explore: ui.select(n) plus frameAt. Click while playing: ui.follow=false; ui.version++; frameAt (the pill shows 🎥). It updates through useStoreVersion (L59-72). Name tags: with a roster in place, lower the CoreMarker scale cap at PlaybackLayer ≈L69 from 3.2 to 2.4 to reduce clutter at overview.
proposals.risk: It must only reflect played events; show.* is fed by apply(), so it already does. In 'simulating', show tokens without colour. On phones, hide the strip while playing if the top row overflows.

proposals.title: Explore NowLine as an honest '鎮上日常' feed with fly-to
proposals.player_experience: Before whispering, the bottom line narrates small town life as it happens: '☕ 美咲在咖啡廳門口跟熟客聊開了', '🐈 麻糬在花店門口打盹', '🐙 阿珠對著攤位費公告嘆氣'. Tapping the line glides the camera there. The town feels lived in, and the feed doubles as a tour of where the core residents are and what they are like. A slate '鎮上日常' chip labels it, so it is never mistaken for the Gemma story.
proposals.inspired_by: RimWorld / Dwarf Fortress ambient log; The Sims notifications; Two Point PA
proposals.implementation: New src/town/ambient.ts: export const ambient = { feed: [] as {key, icon, text, x, z, at}[], version: 0, push(e) { …cap at 8…; this.version++ } }. Producers (procedural, no model calls): crowdSim.ts when a chat or working state starts, especially for core residents at their posts and the lead's new vignettes; petSim.ts when a pet sleeps, begs or plays, reusing the label format of director meanwhileSpot (L298-305). Rate-limit to one line per about 6 s and prefer items near the camera target or involving core residents. useStoreVersion (L59-72) adds ambient.version. GameUI explore NowLine shows ambient.feed.at(-1) with the prefix 鎮上日常. Never use violet, which is the AI and seed colour. onClick calls frameAt(x,z,22). Do not show the feed during playing or results; the director's meanwhile stays the only ambient beat there.
proposals.risk: It depends on the lead's vignette work. With only pets and generic chats the feed will feel thin. Vignettes must never state story facts (stage, oven, budget) or anything the engine treats as knowledge.

proposals.title: Power chips reuse the compose tool vocabulary and cover every tool
proposals.player_experience: When a believer with a tool is on screen, the pulsing chip over their head uses the exact words from the whisper card ('🚓 派警力？', '✊ 號召攤商？', '🚪 會關店嗎？'). The suspense links back to what the player read when choosing them. Vendors and shopkeepers get chips too.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitchcock's bomb under the table (already in code); Hitman opportunity markers
proposals.implementation: PlaybackLayer L20: build POWER from persona.actions × TOOL (roles.ts, proposal 1), at most two tools per person. Extend doneBig (L29) to treat key.startsWith('shops.'), gather, statement and notice as done. Keep the existing conf >= 0.6 and 'no line over head' rules (L31).
proposals.risk: More chips mean more clutter. Keep the conf threshold and at most one chip in frame (the focused or closest one) if it gets busy.

proposals.title: One '📼 實驗紀錄' popover for recorded runs and personal history
proposals.player_experience: A single 📼 in the explore corner pill opens two short lists: 你的實驗 (last 4) and 錄製的真實模擬. The whisper card no longer carries a history list.
proposals.implementation: Merge GameUI L546-555 (recorded) and L599-608 (history) into a popover 'pointer-events-auto absolute bottom-14 right-3 w-[min(92vw,420px)] rounded-2xl bg-white/95 p-3 shadow-xl' with two headed sections. Keep the button's accessible text '📼 錄製的實驗' (lab/e2e.mjs L45, e2e-prod.mjs L19) and the row prefix '📼 對' (e2e L51), or update both scripts in the same change.

proposals.title: (Experiment) Reserve a UI slot for one mid-run whisper
proposals.player_experience: If the lead's experiment shows it is more fun: when the story goes quiet and nobody is thinking, NowLine offers '💬 再補一句（剩 1 次）'. It opens the same whisper card with the cast strip showing who currently believes what. One extra nudge, never a control panel.
proposals.inspired_by: Plague Inc. (spending points mid-run on a stalling outbreak); Hitman (improvising when the plan stalls)
proposals.implementation: UI only: a button inside NowLine when !show.growing is false, show.thinking.size===0, show.stalled is false, and no world event has played for N game minutes (or a director flag the engine sets). It reuses the proposal 1 card in a mode prop with a one-use counter stored in GameUI state. The engine side (injecting a second seed into a running simulate) belongs to the lead, which is why this is L.
proposals.risk: It can turn watching into fiddling and complicates the honest log (two seeds). A/B it against pure watching before shipping. Skip it if time is short; it is not needed for the UI cleanup.
